string-array.name: faq_about_description
string-array.item: "Scholarly BECE JSS app is an android application that is designed to help students learn, pass exams and gain admission into higher institutions"
"You can download the app from google play store or collect the app from your friends through bluetooth or xender."

"1. Mobility: you can carry your phone anywhere and study wherever you are.

2. CBT: with this app you can time yourself and take exams just like WAEC CBT

3. All in one: Rather than having different booklets for different subjects. In this app all your BECE JSS subjects are in one app.

4. Customer support: with this app, you have people to go to if you have questions or complaints.

5. Audio question/answers: questions/answers and explanation can be read to you, meaning you can learn by listening rather than reading.

6. Save questions for later: you can save questions that matter to you so that you can easily find them later.

7. Detailed result breakdown: see how you performed at various subjects, visual representations like bar chart and tables.

8. Built in scientific calculator: use the app's BECE JSS like calculator without having to use an external device or calculator.

9. Practice one or more subjects at once: take a test or exam in more than one subjects at a time.

10. Shuffle questions/options: test your remembering ability by rearranging the questions and options order.

11. Profile: personalize your app using our feature rich profile screen. update your picture, email, fullname, phone etc."

"2. Explanation to every question: This app provides concise explanation to every question be it mathematical or non mathematical.

2. Interactive learning: with features like CBT game and study past questions, you learn in a fun filled and interactive manner

3.Customizable: Customize the app features to suit your needs with its preference setting.

4. Easy to use: This app has been designed with you in mind. It affords users a wonderful user experience with its intuitive user interface.

5. Notifications/SMS: Get notified and alerted with the latest information on admissions, universities.

6. Share questions/score: with this app you can share difficult questions you encountered to your friends via different social media platform. Also share your results to friends"
"Any student who wants to learn, pass exam and gain admission into higher institutions"
